content.text: Experienced California Personal Injury Lawyers Protecting Your RightsExperienced Counsel Serving Clients Throughout CaliforniaHas an accident left you or a loved one dealing with debilitating injuries, emotional trauma, and financial problems? There is hope.You may be entitled to a significant amount of financial compensation for your medical bills, lost wages, and other physical or psychological harm you have experienced. A Personal Injury attorney from our firm can advise you of your rights and options and can pursue the monetary damages you need to start putting your life back together.What Constitutes Personal Injury?Personal injury refers to physical or psychological harm that is inflicted on a person as a result of someone else’s negligence or intentional wrongdoing. This harm can result from a wide range of incidents, such as car accidents, slip and falls, medical malpractice, and product defects. In personal injury cases, the injured person may be entitled to compensation for their damages, including medical expenses, lost wages, and pain and suffering. It’s important to seek legal representation from an experienced Personal Injury lawyer who can help you navigate the complex legal process and fight for the compensation you deserve. At McCune Law Group, we have a team of skilled attorneys who are dedicated to helping our clients recover from their injuries and obtain the maximum compensation possible.Understanding Your Rights and Legal Options in CaliforniaWhen facing an injury due to another party’s actions or negligence, understanding the legal grounds for a personal injury lawsuit can be overwhelming. California personal injury law allows injured individuals to seek monetary compensation for various accident-related injuries, including physical injuries and emotional trauma.Personal Injury Claims and Potential DamagesIn a personal injury lawsuit, plaintiffs may seek compensation for injuries sustained in various accidents, from auto accidents to workplace injuries. The injured party is entitled to pursue damages that account for both bodily injuries and property damage, with insurance companies often involved in determining damage coverage. Personal injury liability insurance held by the fault party typically provides damage coverage for medical costs, loss of income, and financial losses associated with the accident.Types of Compensation You Can SeekCalifornia allows injured individuals to pursue multiple types of compensation, depending on the type of injury and circumstances of the case. Standard damages may cover medical treatment, medical care, and ongoing medical costs related to injury-related expenses. In cases of serious negligence or recklessness, punitive damages may also be awarded to punish the defendant liable for the harm caused.Medical Expenses: Plaintiffs may seek reimbursement for medical costs arising from the accident-related injuries. This includes both immediate medical treatment and ongoing medical care as necessary.Lost Income and Future Earnings: If the injured party loses income or the potential to earn in the future, the claim may include loss of income as part of the personal injury lawsuit.Property Damage: Many auto accident cases also involve property damage, with personal injury liability insurance covering damage to vehicles or other personal property affected by the incident.Punitive Damages: When punitive damages apply, they serve as a deterrent against reckless behavior and ensure the defendant liable faces financial penalties for severe misconduct.The Role of an Experienced California Personal Injury LawyerNavigating a potential lawsuit requires an in-depth understanding of personal injury law and the intricacies of dealing with insurance companies. An experienced lawyer can help negotiate with insurance companies to secure fair compensation for injuries and handle complex claims that may involve workplace injuries, auto accidents, or other serious incidents.Why Choose McCune Law Group?At McCune Law Group, we understand the serious effects of personal injury law cases on clients and their families. Our attorneys strive to ensure each client receives monetary compensation that fully reflects their medical costs, physical injuries, and emotional suffering, along with any financial losses from lost income or future medical care.What Is My Case Worth?The primary concern in a personal injury lawsuit will be what it is worth, or what amount of compensation the injured party may be entitled to receive. Of course, there is no way to fully compensate a person for experiencing a disabling injury or losing a loved one, but a favorable verdict or settlement can make all the difference in a victim’s ability to rebuild and experience peace of mind.Depending on the case, you may be entitled to compensation for:Current and future lost wages and earningsMedical bills, for lifePain and sufferingPunitive damagesWith a California personal injury attorney from McCune Law Group on you can rest assured that we are doing everything we can to make sure you and your family are fully compensated for your losses and that wrongdoers are held accountable for their actions.Frequently Asked Questions:What is a personal injury case? A personal injury case is a legal dispute that arises when one person is injured or harmed by the actions or negligence of another person, business, or organization. The purpose of a personal injury claim is to seek compensation for the damages suffered as a result of the injury.What are the common types of personal injury cases? Some common types of personal injury cases include car accidents, slip and fall accidents, product liability, workplace accidents, and wrongful death.How do I know if I have a personal injury case? If you have been injured due to the actions or negligence of another person, business, or organization, you may have a personal injury case. However, the specific circumstances of your case will need to be evaluated by one of our Personal Injury attorneys to determine if you have a viable case.What should I do if I am injured in an accident? If you are injured in an accident, you should seek medical attention right away. You should also document the accident by taking pictures, gathering information, and contacting the proper authorities. Additionally, it is important to consult with a personal injury attorney to understand your legal options.How You Can Start a Personal Injury ClaimIf an accident left you or a loved one dealing with debilitating injuries, emotional trauma, or financial problems, you may be entitled to a significant amount of financial compensation for your medical bills, lost wages, and other physical or psychological harm. If you are ready to start a claim, here is what to do:Fill out our contact form with your informationSet up your free consultationMeet with our Personal Injury attorneysDiscuss your potential caseDiscuss your next stepsFind out how we can help you by calling (909) 345-8110. Your consultation is free and confidential.Call McCune Law Group – Because Results MatterLed by partner Cory Weck – a Marine Corps officer with over 20 years of service to his country and 15 years of experience litigating personal injury cases – our personal injury attorneys is committed to seeing that justice is served, and victims are properly compensated in all personal injury and wrongful death matters.In recent years, our attorneys have recovered large verdicts and settlements for clients across the Inland Empire region, including a $4.282 million verdict related to a ski boat manufacturing defect and a $4.25 million verdict in a motorcycle accident matter. When you work with us, our attorneys will fully investigate the circumstances of your injury and use all available resources to prove causation and fight for all available damages in your case.Call McCune Law Group at (909) 345-8110 today for a FREE consultation to see how we can help you.Talk to a California Personal Injury Lawyer Today!McCune Law Group lawyers have been successfully obtaining compensation for clients in personal injury cases for over 30 years. It has resulted in hundreds of millions of dollars in compensation for clients, and dozens of cases with recovery over $1 million. It has included obtaining $13 million for an injured passenger in a car accident and other cases where it has obtained compensation for our clients of over $5 million.McCune Law Group has successfully obtained compensation of over $1 million in car accidents, truck accidents, motorcycle accidents, boat accidents, pedestrian accidents, premise liability accidents, sexual abuse, dangerous roadways and workplace accidents.If you have a potential personal injury or wrongful death case, please contact the personal injury lawyers at McCune Law Group. It is likely we have successfully handled a similar case and will be glad to share our experience and history of success in your type of case.What do I do after an accident? It is important to seek medical attention as soon as possible. Ensure that your doctor documents your injuries and that you return for follow-up appointments. Take pictures of the scene of the accident, if it is safe to do so, and exchange insurance and contact information with the other party. If there were witnesses, take down their contact information as well. Never admit fault to a police officer, insurance agent, or the other party, and speak to your attorney before taking any insurance settlements.How long do I have to file a personal injury claim? The state has set a two-year statute of limitations that starts counting down from the date of the accident or injury. Under most circumstances, if you do not file within this two-year period, you may not be able to do so in the future.Will my case go to trial? Most personal injury claims are settled out of court and some before a lawsuit is even filed. However, in order to seek full and fair compensation, a civil trial may be necessary.Do I need a personal injury attorney? Personal injury lawyers have studied the law and have insight and experience into how to negotiate, settle, and try cases. Insurance companies employ legal teams to protect their company’s bottom line. Standing up against them can be a challenge for the everyday individual, especially when they are already dealing with the pain and trauma of a serious injury.
